notes.title: Our Valentine's gift to you!
notes.content:
Hello Matchmakers!

Happy Valentine's! We've got a massive romantic update for you.

Our first gift to you is voice acting! We've had the voices for most of our characters added into the game, so you'll get to hear them in combat, and at the start of most conversations. We're still working to get Calyx recorded, but everyone else can finally be heard for the first time.

The second gift is dungeon activities! Konstantina and Eldoris have new tasks you can help them with, and if you do, they'll reward you with battle equipment and valuable gems. Use these as a way to diversify what you do with your time, and get those last little things your build needs to be combat ready.

The third gift is screen resolutions. A weird gift, for sure, but a very practical one. We've overhauled all of our UI so we can support more than just 16:9 aspects, so any screen should be able to enjoy Dungeon Heart (including steam deck, which we did a lot of testing for)

And the fourth and final gift is some new tutorials. With so much to do now in Dungeon Heart, it can be hard to remember how everything works, so we've added some little explainers to help out. This should also clarify how daily spirits work from the last update.

But it wouldn't be a special day if we were the only ones out here giving gifts, so now you can give gifts too! From your inventory, you can now use items out of combat, or give items as gifts to romanceable characters! Get those extra friendship points and clean out your inventory at the same time, it's a win-win.

We've also extended the game's length. You've got an extra week of conversations, training fights now scale to level 5, and there's a new extra hard 3rd boss phase to try out. Plus, you can now confess your love for datable characters!

We're getting very close to the end now. The next major update will be the final one, and will bring in the conclusion of the story, as well as complete all the features we've always envisioned for the game. We can't wait to have the finished product, and we're very thankful for everyone supporting us on the way there. Patch notes below, happy Valentine's <3
-Ghost Moth

(All the imps have gathered today, though Noodle, Kira and Moosifer refused to put on construction gear)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44560074/5c1a150973af22ee56aa4e2ef5f1216777df86b0.png
Version 1.7.0 Patch notes
Added:

Datable characters have voices! (except Calyx)
All boss fights now have a third, much tougher fight
All training combats now scale to level 5 with +attacks
Dungeon activities Salvage and Forge
Can collect recipes for forging (and eventually cooking)
Using items from inventory and gifting items
New rendezvous for Oren
Love confessions that set you on a romantic path
All character assists up to level 5 friendship
New items added that are gifted during daily conversation and in the shop
New burning debuff, caused by new items and Jett's carefree concoctions.
New tutorials for bone mechanic, training, forging, delving, séance, healing and sleeping


Changes:

All screen aspects now supported
Non-combat puzzles will now have different, less violent effects
Typos and grammatical errors caught and collected
Research items now state they have a pre-requisite
Refresh icon has different art/hitbox, so it is harder to click accidentally
Stun condition now clearly indicates what you have to do to clear it
New art assets for gems and several combat specific motes
Gave Philomela a little bit more HP at all levels


Bug fixes:

Journal hearts will now fill correctly to indicate relationship status
Dungeon activities (such as séance) should no longer unlock early by having a daily conversation
Gaining an item when you have an empty slot or using the last use of a consumable item in combat will now update the item bar correctly
Map close button no longer blocked by clock on some resolutions
Can no longer go on a date with someone who has no dates left to go on
The monster from the tutorial should no longer jump in size


If you read all that, thanks. The game is quite big now, and it's hard to test everything in there extensively, so if you spot something wrong, please let us know in the forums, ty <3

notes.title: Cut the Smalltalk update is out!
notes.content:
Hello Matchmakers!

We're bringing you a massive update in the first minutes of December!

The big ticket item for this version are the new talking animations! The datable characters are so much more expressive now, and we love how they look. Huge shout out to our artist and programmer that got all of these working in the span of just 1 month!

In addition to this, we've seen the comments about our typos, spelling and grammatical errors, and we got pretty embarrassed. So, we made a new workflow and we've identified and corrected over 300 of them. (ːsteamfacepalmː so many...)
There will still be some lingering in our massive script, but hopefully the dramatically reduced occurrences  will put some of you at ease.

Lastly, we've got new content to spice up your daily dungeon life, and support for a few different screen sizes. We're still working on steam deck resolution, but hopefully we'll have a lot more supported sizes in our full release.

Thanks for reading these and following along with our development. Our next major update is unlikely to release in December will all the features we were hoping, but we're trying our best to get this game completed. Patch notes below, happy matching!
-Ghost Moth

(I think this is some kind of imp soup heist?)

Version 1.6.0 Patch notes
Added:

All boss fights now have a second fight, including the new boss!
Datable characters now talk with their mouths, blink, and idle around!
 New boss has unique music track and sound effects
Gave multiple combatants blocking moves so they can stay in fights a bit longer (and pressure you to attack or use anti-block assists)
Spirits that change how you play each day based on their mood
A dungeon activity to appease the spirits
An animated title screen background based on your last location!
Windowed and Fullscreen support
Support for three 16:9 screen resolutions


Changes:

Fixed 305 text errors in the script
Eldoris' chance attacks are now a bit more likely to deal damage
Consumable items in the vault are significantly cheaper than before
Increased relationship points given by combat reward (1->3)
Temporal Bloom research cost reduced (999 gold -> 200 gold, still hard to get with the current content, but more achievable long-term)
 Hid the dungeon entrance from the map because there was no reason to go there
 Buffs and Debuffs now pulse when they are triggered
 If you acquire a spell or an item while you have empty slots, they are automatically equipped
 All obstacle motes can now be cleared using column, row and area clear motes.


Bug fixes:

Increasing friendship with Eldoris will no longer increase friendship with Konstantina for no reason
Opponent healing and blocking now appear on the correct side of the matchmaker
Journal fills in completed hearts properly
Eldoris' Binding Gift attack will no longer soft-lock combat if it tries to replace itself
Some soft locks that occurred during daily/date dialogue fixed
 Calyx's cooking challenge will now succeed if you do it right, and fail if you do it wrong (it did the opposite before, oops)

notes.title: Version 1.5.1,
notes.content:
Hello Matchmakers!

The imps have finalised the touches on the latest shipment of fixes, balance and improvements. We noticed AJ was quite the challenge in the early game, so we're slowing down his crushing strike attack just enough to allow you to find some extra focus. We're always keeping an eye on the forums and making adjustments based on feedback, so feel free to make suggestions on improvements and balance, we'll see it and likely do something about it. 

As a little update on how we're tracking, the team is currently working at full speed to increase the game's content and features for the next major update. We've also recorded all but a few characters voice acting, and we're preparing to reveal our voice cast over the next few months, so stay tuned on our socials to catch those before anyone else.

As always, full change list is below. Enjoy v1.5.1, and enjoy another imp art piece! (This imp is named Crumbs and he should not be on that anvil)
-Ghost Moth

Changed wording for all status effect tooltips to make their end condition clearer
Changed wording for Passive Bone and Sorcery Multiply buffs

notes.title: The Dreams and Schemes update is here!
notes.content:
Hello Matchmakers!

The Dreams and Schemes update is now live! The imps have been working their hardest to take the game to new heights. You can find a list of patch notes below about all the exciting new content you can find in Dungeon Heart.

The biggest highlights are obviously all the new assets! We've got imp portraits, new sprites for the matchmaker, new daily conversations (especially with AJ and Vanora), bonus puzzles to play, secrets and more!
If you want to see as much new content as possible, starting a new save file is probably a good idea.

We're also preparing for a lot of steam events coming up, including a discount for the game which will be going live soon. If you're going to be at PAX Australia, come say hi! We've got some merch, and we'll be selling the game there to.

We're on track with our roadmap, so while there will certainly be an update between November and now, we have a lot more in store in the next major update.

Enjoy! - Ghost Moth

notes.title: Version 1.4.1, that's a hot fix.
notes.content:
Hello Matchmakers!

We've noticed that the imps have seemingly caused a lot of chaos within our game, so we've given them cute little construction outfits, and put them to work clearing up their messes.

Our team has been hard at work fine tuning and tweaking the elements already in the game.
We've also begun cooking on our first major update, so lots of new content is on the way.

Below you can find the full list of changes and bugfixes, we hope you like the refined v1.4.1!
-Ghost Moth

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44560074/e3c747fae3543587f13059b9984ba9fbb94067c8.png

Version 1.4.1 Patch notes
-Added daily conversations with Jett on days 4, 5 and 7 (if ze is in the tavern).
-Research areas open up after advancing your relationship to tier 2 (formally tier 3).
-Auto-letterboxing has been added as a temporary fix for different screen resolutions.
-Reduced default ambience volume.
-Oren now has his own training defeat lines (and is no longer borrowing Jett’s).
-Added sound effects to the Lone Bone assist.
-Exhaustion debuff has updated icon.

Bug Fixes:
-Talking to Oren more than once in a day will no longer require a soft reset.
-AJ’s stance break will now break sparking motes correctly.
-AJ’s parry will now only block might attacks.
-Spells can no longer be cast when stunned or at 0 magic.
-Fixed a layering issue that hid the icon for the Lone Bone assist.
-Fixed an inventory of 11+ items overflowing the wrong way.
-The audio effects for spells should now line up more accurately with the animations.
-Spells with variable costs will no longer break combat.
-Various spelling and typo fixes (Especially for Calyx, those imps would not leave them alone).
